## AppRegistrar interface

Registers apps on the runtime a server is constructed with.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface AppRegistrar
```

## Remarks

The registration half of the server's runtime, handed to [ServerOptions.register](./api.serveroptions.register.md)<!-- -->. Each call is atomic: an app it refuses (`OperationRegistrationError` from `@macts/runtime`<!-- -->) adds no operations.
